description: This file extends CKEditor 5's image plugin with custom attributes and handles conversion between view and model, specifically for Drupal integration. It manages attributes like data-entity-uuid, data-entity-type, and supports custom image resizing and caption handling.

classes.name: DrupalImageEditing
classes.description: CKEditor 5 plugin class that extends image editing capabilities with Drupal-specific attributes and behaviors.

methods.name: createImageViewElement
methods.description: Creates an empty image view element using the writer.

methods.name: isNumberString
methods.description: Checks if a given value is a string representing a number.

methods.name: downcastPxOrPct
methods.description: Converts a string ending with 'px' or '%' to a numeric string or returns the original if ending with '%'.

methods.name: modelEntityUuidToDataAttribute
methods.description: Generates a converter callback to downcast entity UUID to a data attribute.

methods.name: viewCaptionToCaptionAttribute
methods.description: Creates a callback to convert caption elements into a data-caption attribute.

methods.name: modelEntityTypeToDataAttribute
methods.description: Creates a converter callback to downcast entity type to a data attribute.

methods.name: modelImageStyleToDataAttribute
methods.description: Creates a converter callback to downcast image style (alignment) to a data attribute.

methods.name: viewImageToModelImage
methods.description: Converts view image elements to model elements, handling attributes like src, caption, and custom data attributes.

methods.name: upcastImageBlockLinkGhsAttributes
methods.description: Handles GHS attributes for links wrapping images during upcast.

methods.name: downcastBlockImageLink
methods.description: Converts model link attributes into view link elements wrapping images.

methods.name: dataDowncastBlockImageLink
methods.description: Handles downcasting of link attributes into view link elements.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, extending schema, and setting up conversion rules for CKEditor 5.
